targets.authors: Rydell, R. J., McConnell, A. R., Mackie, D. M., & Strain, L. M.
targets.title: Of Two Minds Forming and Changing Valence-Inconsistent Implicit and Explicit Attitudes.
targets.evidence_quote:
The goal of the first Experiment was to replicate the study of Rydell et al. (2006) as
closely as possible.
targets.outcome_quote:
To conclude, we set out to replicate the finding that briefly presented primes had a
selective influence on participants’ implicit attitudes. In two experiments, we were not able
to replicate the original finding but instead found evidence for its absence.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The concluding overall verdict states that both experiments failed to replicate the original finding; successful explicit-attitude checks do not supersede that verdict.

reasoning: Two completed experiments in fresh German and US samples re-test the Rydell et al. four-author 2006 article. The other Rydell publications are context and earlier replications, not additional targets.
